scenarios.prompt: An actor acquires a grapple target, transfers motion authority to the attached state, swings, then releases with authored velocity. Define stable latch/session identity and owner handoff.

criteria.motion: Exactly one motion owner is active while attached and release velocity policy is declared.
criteria.recovery: Duplicate latch/release requests are idempotent and collision/fall recovery delegates to owning systems.
